basic_info.description: Now just $750,000 with 2 CAR side x side PKG and Huge Deeded Storage Closet with electricity, large enough to be a small office !This cool 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft at Showplace Square Lofts offers 1,180 square feet of stylish living space. Fresh paint, new carpet, and gorgeous refinished maple hardwood floors give the loft a warm, inviting vibe. The open living area with high ceilings, expansive windows and gas fireplace along with a separate dining area is perfect for chilling out or entertaining, and the chef's kitchen is ready for all your cooking adventures.  Upstairs is the Primary Suite, complete with plenty of closet storage and a bathroom that features new designer lighting for that extra touch of flair. There is also a gallery catwalk, perfect for a home office and views of the City. Downstairs there is a second bathroom that boasts new designer lighting and a walk-in shower, making it just as chic and comfortable for guests. Step outside to a shared outdoor patio, perfect for sipping your morning coffee or unwinding in the evening.  You're a short distance from Whole Foods, the vibrant Design District, & have easy access to public transportation and freeways. Pets are welcome! Don't miss out on this chance to live in vibrant Potrero Hill! Run, Don't Walk!
